mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish: the weather is a pleasant 76 degrees with clear skies at Reddan Soccer Park, though note the air quality index is at 52. Tonight features a New Moon, and you can catch the space station passing by for four minutes starting at 9:08 PM, rising in the West over Mount Horeb and heading toward the Northeast near the Home Depot, reaching about halfway up the sky.
In city news, officers responded to a residential burglary on September 10th at a home in the 600 block of Hunter's Cove Way where a suspect was apprehended after a gunshot was reported.
We have plenty of local activity with live music at Bailey's Run and the Wisconsin Brewing Company happening today, plus the Dane County Farmers Market and live music at Paddy Mac's tomorrow.

Regarding the police department's report, on September 10th, nineteen year old Luis Aragon-Zaring was arrested for burglary and recklessly endangering safety following an incident involving a firearm.
The Culver's flavor of the day is the delightful Raspberry Cheesecake. The restaurant is currently open for business and will be serving up treats until their closing time of 10:30 PM tonight.
